name: Cash Is Freedom — 3.5"x2.0" Engraved B&W Handout Card (Front + Back + 10-Up Print PDF)
description:
Print-ready standard 3.5" x 2.0" (88.9 x 50.8 mm) pure black-and-white business card handout designed to hand to people and merchants when paying in physical cash.

• Front Side (Engraved Seal + Hook): Custom monochrome anti-surveillance banknote seal + succinct personal message explaining why cash is private, offline, and fungible.
• Back Side (4 Illustrated Freedom Pillars + Call to Action): Custom monochrome icons & clear explanations of (1) Defeating Mass Surveillance, (2) Working When the Power Goes Out, (3) Transacting Outside the Banking System, and (4) Why Youth Opt-Out Threatens Cash Survival (Use It or Lose It), plus bold Call to Action.
• Interactive Print & Download Hub: https://farrior13.github.io/aegis-club-radar/cash-handout/

• Back 600 DPI PNG: https://farrior13.github.io/aegis-club-radar/cash-handout/cash_card_back_600dpi.png (Mirror: https://iili.io/nkr20V2.png)
